newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures cut losses late, end mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures cut losses late, end mixed.

text.p: May 5 - U.S. debt futures cut losses late, ended mixed. June T-bonds popped up late, buoyed by signs of shortcovering that lifted it above 110-00. Afternnoon rally in U.S. stocks added support. Some said the firmer close aided the bulls' technical price outlook but noted that rise occurred on skimpy volume. Buyers still seen cautious before this week's supplies.
